Agent Name: Coder
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Coder provided an incomplete and inaccurate list of presidential birthplaces in the Python script (`presidential_birthplaces`). The list included only 13 entries, many of which were incorrect (e.g., "Cove Gap, Pa." for Rutherford B. Hayes, who was born in Delaware; "Charles City Co., Va." appearing twice for different presidents without distinction) and was missing several other presidents entirely. Because the distance calculation script relied on this flawed dataset, the resulting identification of the westernmost and easternmost cities (Honolulu and Quincy) was based on incomplete and erroneous data, leading to an incorrect solution.
